title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: September 29, 2026 Market Close - Data reflects market close on September 24, 2026

sections.title: Market Pulse: Mixed Close Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Rate Hike Concerns

items.headline: Wall Street Closes Mixed; Rising Bond Yields and Oil Prices Drive Caution
items.summary: U.S. equities concluded a volatile session on September 24, 2026, with major indices showing a mixed performance. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 edged lower, while the Nasdaq composite saw a slight gain. Investor caution was heightened by persistently rising Treasury yields, increased oil prices due to Middle East uncertainty, and ongoing concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes.

items.headline: ON Semiconductor Rises on Strong Q3 Results
items.summary: ON Semiconductor ($ON) traded significantly higher, driven by third-quarter 2024 financial results that surpassed analyst expectations and resilient demand in automotive and industrial power sectors.

items.headline: Viavi Solutions Surges on CMMC Certification and AI Demand
items.summary: Viavi Solutions ($VIAV) surged after its Aerospace and Defense division achieved Level 2 Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), a key requirement for U.S. Department of Defense contracts, complemented by strong demand for its AI-focused data center testing solutions.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Up on AI Market Expansion Outlook
items.summary: Dell Technologies ($DELL) moved higher following a bullish research note from Morgan Stanley, citing structural expansion in the AI market and a projected 87-fold increase in inference demand by 2030.

items.headline: Meta Platforms Climbs Post-AI Assistant Unveil
items.summary: Meta Platforms ($META) climbed 4.5% on September 24, 2026, a day after unveiling a new handheld gadget for its recently launched AI assistant, indicating positive market reception to its AI advancements.

items.headline: MGM Resorts Slumps as Acquisition Proposal Withdrawn
items.summary: MGM Resorts ($MGM) slumped 11% on September 24, 2026, after media mogul Barry Diller's People withdrew its proposal to purchase the casino operator, leading to a significant drop in its stock price.

items.headline: Oracle Falls on Data Center Notice
items.summary: Oracle ($ORCL) fell 3.5% on September 24, 2026, following reports that the company issued a 'force majeure' notice to a New Mexico data center, impacting investor sentiment.

items.headline: Treasury Yields and Oil Prices Climb, Fueling Inflation Worries
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields continued their ascent on September 24, 2026, with the 10-year yield reaching 5.14% (highest since 2007) and the two-year yield hitting its highest since 2024. Concurrently, Brent crude prices rose above $107 per barrel amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions, raising inflation concerns and pressuring growth stocks.

items.headline: Consumer Confidence Dips to Decade Low in September 2026
items.summary: Americans' confidence in the economy plunged in September 2026, reaching its lowest level since April 2014, according to the Conference Board. This decline is attributed to persistent elevated prices and stagnating wages, exacerbated by geopolitical conflicts.

items.headline: Big Tech Stocks Under Pressure from Rising Yields and Competition
items.summary: Major technology stocks, including Microsoft ($MSFT), Nvidia ($NVDA), Amazon ($AMZN), Alphabet ($GOOGL), and Apple ($AAPL), faced premarket pressure on September 24, 2026. This was primarily driven by rising Treasury yields, which diminish the present value of future earnings for growth-oriented tech companies, alongside intensified AI-related competition.

items.headline: Costco and Scholastic Among Companies Reporting Earnings
items.summary: Costco Wholesale Corp. ($COST) and Scholastic Corp. ($SCHL) were among the companies expected to report their latest financial results after the market close on September 24, 2026, providing key insights into their performance.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Initiates Rate Hikes, Signals More Amid Inflation
items.summary: The Federal Reserve recently raised its benchmark interest rate for the first time since 2023 in an effort to curb stubbornly high inflation. The central bank has signaled that another rate hike could occur later in the year, impacting borrowing costs across the economy.
